body:
## Tracker or smartwatch?

A **fitness tracker** is a slim band that counts steps, tracks heart rate and sleep, and shows notifications. It's light enough to wear in bed and the battery lasts days. A **smartwatch** adds a bigger screen, apps, maps and more workout detail, but most need charging more often. If you mainly want to move more and sleep better, a band like the Fitbit Charge 6 or Inspire 3 is enough. If you want a watch that also replaces your phone for a run, go for a Garmin or a smartwatch.

## How to choose

- **Match your phone.** Apple Watch only works with iPhone. Pixel Watch and Galaxy Watch work best with Android. Fitbit, Garmin and Amazfit work with both.
- **Built-in GPS** matters if you run, cycle or walk without your phone. The Charge 6, Amazfit Active Max and every Garmin here have it; the Inspire 3 uses your phone's GPS.
- **Battery life:** Garmin and Amazfit last far longer than Apple Watch or Pixel Watch, which need charging every day or two.
- **Subscriptions:** Fitbit Premium (Google's paid tier) unlocks extra insights but isn't needed for the basics. Garmin and Amazfit don't charge for their apps. Check before you buy anything that only works with a monthly plan.

## Which one to buy

**For most people:** the **Fitbit Charge 6** at £74.99. It does steps, sleep, heart rate and built-in GPS, and you can pay with your watch through Google Wallet. It's the most complete band-style tracker for the price.

**Cheapest worth buying:** the **Fitbit Inspire 3** at £58.99 covers the basics well and is small enough that you'll forget you're wearing it. A good gift for a parent or grandparent who just wants to see their steps.

**For runners:** the **Garmin Forerunner 165** at £139 is the best-value running watch, with accurate GPS and training plans. If you're training for a half or full marathon, the **Forerunner 265** at £245.47 adds training readiness and HRV status. Our [Garmin deals guide](/guides/garmin-deals-uk/) has the full range, and [gifts for runners](/guides/gifts-for-runners-uk/) has more ideas.

**For the gym and everyday wear:** the **Garmin Vivoactive 6** at £199.74 tracks almost any sport and lasts much longer between charges than an Apple Watch.

**If you want a smartwatch:** the **Apple Watch SE 3** (£194) for iPhone users, the **Galaxy Watch 8** (£219, £130 off) or **Pixel Watch 5** (£299) for Android. Our [smartwatch deals guide](/guides/smartwatch-deals-uk/) compares more models.

## Good prices to look for

From this week's prices: under £60 for the Inspire 3, about £75 for the Charge 6, under £140 for the Forerunner 165 and under £250 for the Forerunner 265 are all good. Fitness trackers often come down again in January as people start new-year fitness plans, but the Black Friday prices above are usually as low as they go.

If they like listening while they walk or run, an [Audible membership](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/) pairs well with a tracker: new members can get 3 months for £0.99 a month until 17 December.

## FAQs

### What is the best fitness tracker in the UK?

For most people, the Fitbit Charge 6: built-in GPS, accurate heart rate and Google Wallet in a slim band, and it's £74.99 at Amazon for Black Friday. Runners will get more from a Garmin Forerunner 165.

### Is a Fitbit or a Garmin better?

Fitbit is better for everyday health, sleep and steps in a simple app. Garmin is better for running, cycling and training, and its watches last longer on a charge. Both work with iPhone and Android.

### Do fitness trackers work with iPhone?

Fitbit, Garmin and Amazfit trackers all work with iPhone. Samsung's Galaxy Watch and Google's Pixel Watch need an Android phone, and the Apple Watch only works with iPhone.

### Do I need a subscription for a fitness tracker?

No, for the trackers here. Steps, heart rate, sleep and workouts are free on Fitbit, Garmin and Amazfit. Fitbit Premium is an optional paid extra for deeper insights.

### Will fitness trackers be cheaper in January?

Sometimes slightly, as brands push new-year fitness, but Black Friday through Cyber Monday is usually the lowest point of the year. If a tracker is at the prices above, it's a good time to buy.
